## NMDS AT SPECIES LEVEL (Bray-Curtis)

```{r nmds, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, tidy=TRUE, tidy.opts=list(width.cutoff=45), paged.print=FALSE}

ps_fringilla <- speedyseq::tax_glom(microb_fr, "Species") %>%
  biomeUtils::removeZeros()

set.seed(1)
ord <- metaMDS(otu_table(ps_fringilla), distance = "bray", k = 8, binary = FALSE)

scrs <- scores(ord, display = 'sites') %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(Species_Label = sample_data(ps_fringilla)$Species_Label)

cent <- aggregate(cbind(NMDS1, NMDS2) ~ Species_Label, data = scrs, FUN = mean)

png(paste0(outputDir, "/Figures/bray_NMDS_species_speciesFix.png"),
    width = 320, height = 240, units = "mm", res = 1000)
(bray_NMDS <- ggplot(scrs, aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, fill = Species_Label, shape = Species_Label)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 1, size = 10, stroke = 1.5, color = "white") +
    geom_point(data = cent, aes(y = NMDS2, x = NMDS1, fill = Species_Label),
               size = 17, stroke = 1.5, color = "black") +
    pca_theme + SpeciesLabel.fill +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.01)) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(21, 22, 23, 21, 23, 25, 21, 21, 21, 22, 25), guide = "none") +
    guides(color = "none"))
dev.off()

```

## PERMANOVA ACROSS TAXONOMIC LEVELS

```{r permanova-helper, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, tidy=TRUE, tidy.opts=list(width.cutoff=45), paged.print=FALSE}

# Runs four distance metrics (Jaccard, Bray-Curtis, unweighted UniFrac, weighted UniFrac)
# for a given taxonomic level. Returns a named list of adonis2 results.
permanova_at_level <- function(ps_base, level, seed = 42) {
  ps <- if (level == "OTU99") ps_base else speedyseq::tax_glom(ps_base, level)
  ps <- ps %>%
    biomeUtils::removeZeros() %>%
    subset_samples(Genus == "Fringilla" & !is.na(Sex) & Age > 0) %>%
    biomeUtils::removeZeros()
  
  jac_dist <- vegdist(otu_table(ps), method = "jaccard", binary = TRUE)
  bray_dist <- vegdist(otu_table(ps), method = "bray", binary = FALSE)
  uw_dist <- UniFrac(ps, weighted = FALSE)
  w_dist <- UniFrac(ps, weighted = TRUE)
  
  formula <- ~ Species_Label + Age_cat + Sex
  
  set.seed(seed); jac  <- adonis2(update(formula, jac_dist  ~ .), data = meta(ps), by = "margin", permutations = 9999)
  set.seed(seed); bray <- adonis2(update(formula, bray_dist ~ .), data = meta(ps), by = "margin", permutations = 9999)
  set.seed(seed); uw   <- adonis2(update(formula, uw_dist   ~ .), data = meta(ps), by = "margin", permutations = 9999)
  set.seed(seed); w    <- adonis2(update(formula, w_dist    ~ .), data = meta(ps), by = "margin", permutations = 9999)
  
  list(Jaccard = jac, `Bray-Curtis` = bray,
       `Unweighted UniFrac` = uw, `Weighted UniFrac` = w)
}

```

```{r permanova-run, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, tidy=TRUE, tidy.opts=list(width.cutoff=45), paged.print=FALSE}

tax_levels <- c("Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species", "OTU99")

results_by_level <- lapply(tax_levels, function(lvl) {
  message("Running PERMANOVA at level: ", lvl)
  permanova_at_level(microb_fr, lvl)
})
names(results_by_level) <- tax_levels

# Print everything for inspection
results_by_level

```

## BUILD COMBINED RESULTS TABLE

```{r table, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, tidy=TRUE, tidy.opts=list(width.cutoff=45), paged.print=FALSE}

# Helper to extract a tidy data frame from one adonis2 result
extract_adonis <- function(adonis_result, distance_metric, taxonomic_level) {
  df <- as.data.frame(adonis_result)
  df$Predictor <- rownames(df)
  df <- df[!df$Predictor %in% c("Residual", "Total"), ]
  
  data.frame(
    `Distance metric` = distance_metric,
    `Taxonomic Level` = taxonomic_level,
    Predictor = df$Predictor,
    R2 = round(df$R2, 3),
    F = round(df$F, 3),
    pvalue = df$`Pr(>F)`,
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# Flatten all results into one table, ordered: Jaccard, Bray, UW UniFrac, W UniFrac
# within each taxonomic level
permanova_table <- bind_rows(lapply(tax_levels, function(lvl) {
  bind_rows(
    extract_adonis(results_by_level[[lvl]]$Jaccard,            "Jaccard",            lvl),
    extract_adonis(results_by_level[[lvl]]$`Bray-Curtis`,      "Bray-Curtis",        lvl),
    extract_adonis(results_by_level[[lvl]]$`Unweighted UniFrac`, "Unweighted UniFrac", lvl),
    extract_adonis(results_by_level[[lvl]]$`Weighted UniFrac`,   "Weighted UniFrac",   lvl)
  )
}))

# Format p-values
permanova_table$pvalue <- ifelse(
  permanova_table$pvalue < 0.001,
  "<0.001",
  formatC(permanova_table$pvalue, format = "f", digits = 3)
)

write.csv(permanova_table,
          file = paste0(outputDir, "/permanova_results_full.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

# To access individual results from R:
# results_by_level[["Family"]][["Bray-Curtis"]]

```
